parameters.name: AllSubClustersSuccess
parameters.description: Specifies whether all sub-instances must pass validation before the GlobalView instance is created. Default value: false, which indicates that partial success is allowed.

parameters.name: ArchiveDuration
parameters.description: The number of days to automatically archive data after the storage period expires. Valid values: 60, 90, 180, and 365. A value of 0 indicates that data is not archived.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The Container Service cluster ID. This parameter is required when ClusterType is set to aliyun-cs.

parameters.name: ClusterName
parameters.description:
The name of the cluster to create. This parameter is required when ClusterType is set to remote-write, ecs, or global-view.

For ecs instances, the ClusterName must follow the format "name-vpc-id", and the name part cannot exceed 24 characters. Example: "mytest1-vpc-xxxxxxxxxxx".

parameters.name: ClusterType
parameters.description:
The instance type. Valid values: 
-  remote-write: Prometheus for Remote Write.
-  ecs (no longer supported): Prometheus for ECS.
-  global-view: Prometheus for GlobalView.
-  aliyun-cs (no longer supported): Prometheus for Container Service.
- cloud-product (no longer supported): Prometheus for Cloud Service.
- cloud-monitor (no longer supported): Prometheus for Hybrid Cloud Monitoring.
- flink (no longer supported): Prometheus for Flink.

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: The data storage duration, in days.

parameters.name: GrafanaInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the bound Grafana workspace. Set this parameter to "free" when you use the shared Grafana edition.

parameters.name: PaymentType
parameters.description:
The Billable methods. Valid values:
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go based on the number of reported metrics.
POSTPAY_GB: pay-as-you-go based on the volume of written metrics.
Empty: uses the default billing method configured by the user. If no default is configured, the system defaults to billing based on the number of reported metrics.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The Network Security group ID. This parameter is required when ClusterType is set to ecs or aliyun-cs for a managed ASK cluster.

parameters.name: SubClustersJson
parameters.description: The JSON string of sub-instances for the GlobalView instance.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID. This parameter is required when ClusterType is set to ecs or aliyun-cs for a managed ASK cluster.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The VPC ID. This parameter is required when ClusterType is set to ecs or aliyun-cs for a managed ASK cluster.
